_note: Set kitFolder to the desired folder, e.g. "D:\Music\Dubgefahren\Kits" (Windows) or "%HOME%/Music/Dubgefahren/Kits" (macOS). Environment variables such as %USERPROFILE% (Windows) or %HOME% (macOS) are allowed. Empty = Documents/Dubgefahren/Kits. Editing requires administrator rights if the plugin is located under Program Files.
